description: This file contains JavaScript code for the CKEditor plugin 'pastefromword', including functions for parsing and cleaning HTML content pasted from Microsoft Word, and extending CKEDITOR.htmlParser prototypes.

methods.name: onlyChild
methods.description: Returns the only child of a fragment or null if there isn't exactly one child.

methods.name: removeAnyChildWithName
methods.description: Removes all children with a specific name from an element.

methods.name: getAncestor
methods.description: Finds the nearest ancestor matching a given name or pattern.

methods.name: firstChild
methods.description: Finds the first child element matching a predicate.

methods.name: addStyle
methods.description: Adds or updates a style attribute on an element.

methods.name: cleanWord
methods.description: Cleans HTML content pasted from Word, removing Word-specific markup.
